# Breach to Claim

> Open class-action data-breach and privacy settlements in the US, each read off its official court-authorized settlement website: claim deadline, what it pays, who is in the class, and where to file. Independent; not legal advice. Updated 2026-11-23T22:47:04.268Z.

- 79 settlements open for claims; 38 close within 30 days, 10 within 7.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/mcp — tools find_breach_settlement, list_open_breach_settlements, breach_settlement_details.
- Full list as JSON: https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/settlements.json
- Each settlement page: https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/s/<slug>/
